name: Deore LX front hydraulic disc-brake caliper with adapter
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 183 g for one front BR-M585 hydraulic caliper assembly with brake pads, mounting bolts and its International Standard adapter. The complete factory-caliper reference includes pads, but the weight table does not select a pad compound. Lever, hose and rotor are separate components. The weight table does not identify the adapter size; no adapter or rotor weight is added or subtracted.
